SELECT id, contents, writer_uid, board_id, ref_comment_id, status, created_at, updated_at, writerNickname, writerProfileUrl, likeCount, liked FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.contents, c.writer_uid, c.board_id, c.ref_comment_id, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
u.nickname AS writerNickname, u.profile_url AS writerProfileUrl,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment_like l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id) AS likeCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment_like l2 WHERE l2.comment_id = c.id AND l2.user_uid = #{loginUid}) AS liked FROM board_comment c LEFT JOIN user_info u ON c.writer_uid = u.uuid WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ) t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.contents, c.writer_uid, c.board_id, c.ref_comment_id, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
u.nickname AS writerNickname, u.profile_url AS writerProfileUrl,
/* 좋아요 수 */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment_like l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id) AS likeCount,
/* 로그인한 사용자가 좋아요 눌렀는지 */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment_like l2 WHERE l2.comment_id = c.id AND l2.user_uid = #{loginUid}) AS liked
FROM board_comment c LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.uuid = c.writer_uid
WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} AND c.status = 'active' AND c.ref_comment_id = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment_like l3 WHERE l3.comment_id = c.id ) >= 1
ORDER BY likeCount DESC, c.created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
